holdings.reason: Only memo rated BUY-candidate: 10.9% FCF yield, 10.5x EV/EBIT, ARR +11.5%, near-zero net debt. Starter size because of AI-disruption and earnings event risk.
holdings.thesis: A cash machine priced for decline. ARR, RPO and margins are still rising, and buybacks are shrinking the share count about 9%. Holding low-single-digit FCF growth beats the index from a 10% yield, and stabilisation re-rates it.
breaks: Total ARR growth below 8% at FY2026 year end, or two quarters of deceleration
FCF margin below 35% for two quarters
RPO growth below revenue growth for two quarters, or share count stops shrinking / acquisition over ~10% of market cap

answer.risks: One small position is a contrarian value/anti-momentum bet on AI not disrupting creative software. It is barely correlated with the S&P 500 (0.08), so its tracking error is mostly idiosyncratic. The satellite trails if ADBE keeps de-rating on AI fears or earnings show ARR slowing. Its 4% size limits the damage, and the core carries the market and AI exposure.
